# The Backrooms

> The Backrooms is a free, open-source first-person survival-horror game that starts instantly in a WebGL-capable browser with no account, installation, or ads.

Each run explores a seeded, procedurally generated descent through six levels. Players manage survival resources, scavenge equipment, evade or fight entities, collect fuses, and seek the final escape portal. Desktop and touch controls are supported.

## Game guide

- [The Backrooms overview](https://backrooms.4oli.com/index.md): Concise, LLM-friendly game description, progression, controls, technical requirements, and suitable recommendations.
- [Play The Backrooms](https://backrooms.4oli.com/): Live game and human-readable landing page.
